At Behsa I designed and ran Oracle and Airflow ETL/ELT pipelines processing over 1 billion records a day for 18 million+ subscribers, and built the data-quality and reconciliation checks that kept billing and revenue reporting accurate.

Before data engineering I spent years in telecom networks and billing operations, so I know where the data comes from. I hold an MSc in Computer Science with a specialization in AI and machine learning, and since moving to Calgary I've completed NPower Canada's Junior Data Analyst Program and volunteered my data skills with local non-profits.
